test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Match the following Judo terms with their correct descriptions:

 

 
 

 Column A (Terms)
 Column B (Descriptions)
 
 
 
 

 A. Ippon
 1. Major rule breach leading to disqualification
 
 

 B. Hansoku-make
 2. Immediate victory by throw, hold, or submission
 
 

 C. Waza-ari
 3. Partial point for lesser throw or 10-second hold
 
 

 D. Sixth kyu (Senior)
 4. Beginner rank indicated by a light blue belt
solution:
The correct answer is __**A-2, B-1, C-3, D-4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ippon (A-2)**: In the sport of **Judo**, an **Ippon** is the highest score a contestant can achieve, resulting in an immediate victory and the end of the match. It is awarded when a player throws their opponent on their back with **speed**, **force**, and **control**. Additionally, it can be achieved through a **submission** (choke or joint lock) or by pinning an opponent for a total of **20 seconds**. ***Hence, statement A-2 is correct.***
 
• **Hansoku-make (B-1)**: This term refers to a **major rule breach** or a grave infringement of the rules of **Judo**. It results in the immediate **disqualification** of the offending player. A **Hansoku-make** can be given directly for a dangerous action or accumulated through **3 Shidos** (minor penalties). In some cases, it may lead to being barred from the entire tournament. ***Hence, statement B-1 is correct.***
 
• **Waza-ari (C-3)**: A **Waza-ari** is a partial point awarded for a throw that is successful but lacks one
